# Introduction

Welcome to the JSMP Analysis Project, a volunteer effort to critically examine the Correctional Facility Master Plan (CFMP) in the JSMP. The Jail System Master Plan is the original name of the Sacramento County Board of Supervisor's planning process to further examine the future of jail system reforms, partly in response to the Mays Consent Decree. A result of this planning process, the CFMP Final Report was commissioned.

This site is a work in progress and is expect to change iteratively through the first half of 2027. Check back regularly for updates.

# Site Navigation

In the **Study Guide**, you'll find brief summaries and commentaries of some of the key documents of the JSMP.

# Key Documents

## The Second Memorandum of Agreement

Although not strictly part of the CFMP, this document serves a prelude to the CFMP final report.

## The Final Report

This report, published on October 30, 2026, consists of the following files.

```{r}
#| echo: false
tb <- sch$pdf_inventory %>%
  dplyr::filter(type == "final_report") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(file = utils::URLdecode(base)) %>%
  dplyr::select(file, pages)

kableExtra::kable(tb)
```
